output.description: The final grounded answer to the user's question, with a principled status enum that distinguishes confident answers from every flavor of abstention.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The outcome of the answer attempt. Distinguishes full answers, partial answers, and the different reasons for abstention.

fields.name: answer
fields.description: The strictest, shortest grounded value answering the question — a bare scalar, name, yes/no, or JSON array for lists — with no prose or preamble. For any abstention status (insufficient_evidence, not_in_documents, not_answerable_from_documents), the literal string 'Not answerable'. Never empty.

fields.name: explanation
fields.description: Optional prose reasoning and elaboration behind the answer. For abstentions, explains why. Empty when the answer stands alone.

fields.name: supporting_passages
fields.description: Every passage used to construct the answer. Empty list when nothing was cited.

fields.name: contradictions_noted
fields.description: Any contradictions the answer had to navigate, surfaced to the user. Empty list if none.

fields.name: caveats
fields.description: What was missing, what assumptions were made, or what the user should know about the answer's limits. For abstentions, this explains the reason.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Qualitative confidence in the answer, grounded in evidence sufficiency — not in the model's prior.
